The F-P ray starts by passing through the virtual focus F' before hitting the lens, and then it emerges parallel to the principal axis, the horizontal line through the lens center.
copy.tl:
Ano ang pinagkaiba ng F-P ray sa P-F ray?

Ang F-P ray ay nagsisimula sa pagdaan sa virtual focus F' bago tumama sa lens, at pagkatapos ay lumalabas ito parallel sa principal axis, ang pahalang na linya sa gitna ng lens.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang kalainan sa F-P ray ug sa P-F ray?

Ang F-P ray magsugod pinaagi sa pag-agi sa virtual focus F' sa dili pa moigo sa lens, ug dayon mogawas kini parallel sa principal axis, ang pinahigda nga linya sa tunga sa lens.

copy.bis: Ang nasal cavity, ang luna sa sulod sa imong ilong, maoy mobasa ug mosala sa hangin nga imong gihanggab sa dili pa kini mopaingon sa mas lawom nga parte sa imong lawas.

Bakit pareho ang daanan ng pagkain at hangin sa aking lalamunan?

Ang pharynx ay common passageway ng pagkain, tubig, at hangin! Ito ang bahagi ng lalamunan kung saan nagtatagpo ang daanan ng pagkain at paghinga.
copy.bis:
Ngano man nga ang pagkaon ug hangin moagi sa samang lugar sa akong tutunlan?

Ang pharynx usa ka common passageway sa pagkaon, tubig, ug hangin! Kini ang parte sa tutunlan diin magtagbo ang agianan sa pagkaon ug pagginhawa.

copy.bis: Ang mga mangingisda, surfers, ug scientists nagtagad sa tides tungod kay ang nag-usab-usab nga lebel sa tubig nakaapekto sa ilang trabaho ug mga kalihokan.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: they are different species: Panthera tigris and Panthera leo.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and describe the outer body parts of animals, such as head, legs or wings, and identify their role to move and to gather food
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses species classification within the genus Panthera, not the outer body parts of animals (head, legs, wings) or their roles in movement and food gathering. It provides no instructional support for the competency.

copy.en:
Are tigers and lions the same species?

No! They are in the same genus, Panthera, but they are different species: Panthera tigris and Panthera leo.
copy.tl:
Pareho bang species ang tigre at leon?

Hindi! Pareho silang nasa genus na Panthera, ngunit magkaiba sila ng species: Panthera tigris at Panthera leo.
copy.bis:
Parehas ba og species ang tigre ug leon?

Dili! Parehas sila nga naa sa genus nga Panthera, apan lahi sila og species: Panthera tigris ug Panthera leo.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The time to reach maximum height is t = v0 sin θ / g
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: determine how forces can change the shape of objects such as when they are pushed, pulled, stretched, bent, twisted, or squeezed
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches projectile motion (time to maximum height), which is unrelated to the competency about forces changing the shape of objects (pushed, pulled, stretched, bent, twisted, squeezed).

copy.en: The time to reach maximum height is t = v0 sin θ / g, so a faster launch or a steeper angle gives more time to climb.
copy.tl: Ang oras para maabot ang maximum height ay t = v0 sin θ / g, kaya mas mabilis na paghagis o mas matarik na anggulo ang nagbibigay ng mas mahabang oras para umakyat.
copy.bis: Ang oras aron maabot ang maximum height mao ang t = v0 sin θ / g, busa mas kusog nga paglabay o mas titip nga anggulo naghatag ug mas taas nga oras sa pagsaka.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Tincture of iodine is a solution used to disinfect wounds, where iodine crystals are the solute and water is the solvent.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify what proportion of the Earth's surface is covered with water as opposed to land
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a solution's solute and solvent (chemistry), not the proportion of Earth's surface covered by water versus land. It provides no instructional support for G8-E-1.

copy.en: Tincture of iodine is a solution used to disinfect wounds, where iodine crystals are the solute and water is the solvent.
copy.tl: Ang tincture of iodine ay isang solution na ginagamit sa pagdidisinfect ng mga sugat, kung saan ang iodine crystals ang solute at ang tubig ang solvent.
copy.bis: Ang tincture of iodine usa ka solution nga gigamit sa pag-disinfect sa mga samad, diin ang iodine crystals mao ang solute ug ang tubig mao ang solvent.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Microorganisms are tiny living things you can only see through a microscope
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the structures, movements and events that occur at each type of plate boundary
assignedReviews.reason: Card describes soil microorganisms decomposing organic matter; no relation to plate boundary structures, movements, or events.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Microorganisms are tiny living things you can only see through a microscope
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the types of plate boundaries found around the Earth
assignedReviews.reason: Card is about soil microorganisms and nutrient cycling, not types of plate boundaries.

copy.en: Microorganisms are tiny living things you can only see through a microscope, and they help decompose organic matter in soil into nutrients for plants.
copy.tl: Ang mga microorganism ay napakaliit na bagay na may buhay na makikita lang sa pamamagitan ng microscope, at tinutulungan nilang maagnas ang organic matter sa lupa para maging nutrients ng mga halaman.
copy.bis: Ang mga microorganism kay gagmay kaayo nga buhing butang nga makita lamang pinaagi sa microscope, ug motabang sila sa pagdugta sa organic matter sa yuta aron mahimong nutrients sa mga tanom.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: How much energy does a 1200-watt toaster use in 20 days?
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the role of greenhouse gases in enhanced global warming and climate change
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about calculating electrical energy consumption of a toaster, which is a physics/energy topic. G10-E-9 concerns the role of greenhouse gases in global warming and climate change, which is unrelated to the card's content.

copy.en:
How much energy does a 1200-watt toaster use in 20 days?

It uses 12 kilowatt-hours, because 1200 watts times 10 total hours equals 12,000 watt-hours!
copy.tl:
Ilang enerhiya ang gamit ng 1200-watt toaster sa 20 araw?

Gumagamit ito ng 12 kilowatt-hours, dahil ang 1200 watts na minultiplika sa 10 kabuuang oras ay katumbas ng 12,000 watt-hours!
copy.bis:
Pila ka enerhiya ang gamiton sa 1200-watt toaster sa 20 ka adlaw?

Naggamit kini ug 12 kilowatt-hours, tungod kay ang 1200 watts nga gipadaghan sa 10 ka kinatibuk-ang oras katumbas sa 12,000 watt-hours!

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe the root and shoot system in plants and describe why they are important
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses culinary uses of tomatoes, not the root and shoot system of plants or their importance. No instructional support for the competency.

copy.tl: Napakagamit ng kamatis sa kusina—ginagamit ito sa pagluluto, sarsa, at ensalada!
copy.bis: Dako kaayog gamit ang kamatis sa kusina—gigamit kini sa pagluto, sarsa, ug ensalada!

assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses daily waste generation and landfill capacity, which is unrelated to safety precautions for household electrical devices.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify that electricity is a flow of electrons and show appreciation for the need to observe safe measures in handling electricity
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about waste and landfill capacity, not about electricity as a flow of electrons or safe handling of electricity.

copy.en: Every day, people create more waste than landfills can hold, so some garbage is left uncollected.
copy.tl: Araw-araw, mas marami ang basurang nagagawa natin kaysa sa kayang tanggapin ng mga landfill, kaya may mga basurang hindi nakokolekta.
copy.bis: Kada adlaw, mas daghan ang basura nga atong mahimo kaysa sa masulod sa mga landfill, busa naay mga basura nga dili makolekta.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Distance is measured using simple tools like a ruler for short lengths or a meterstick for longer ones.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe changes in properties of materials when exposed to certain changes in temperature, such as changes when wood or coal are burned
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about measuring distance with simple tools, which is unrelated to the competency's focus on changes in material properties due to temperature (e.g., burning wood or coal).

copy.en: Distance is measured using simple tools like a ruler for short lengths or a meterstick for longer ones.
copy.tl: Ang distance ay sinusukat gamit ang mga simpleng tools tulad ng ruler para sa maiikling haba o meterstick para sa mas mahahabang haba.
copy.bis: Ang distance gisukod gamit ang mga simple nga tools sama sa ruler para sa mugbo nga mga gitas-on o meterstick para sa mas tag-as nga mga gitas-on.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Topography, the physical shape and features of the land, affects climate
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify and appropriately use units in simple science activities, such as milligrams (mg), grams (g), kilograms (kg), and degrees centigrade (C)
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains how topography (mountains) affects climate. It contains no content about identifying or using measurement units such as milligrams, grams, kilograms, or degrees centigrade, which is the focus of G5-M-8.

copy.en: Topography, the physical shape and features of the land, affects climate because mountains act as barriers to air movement and moisture.
copy.tl: Ang topography, o ang pisikal na hugis at katangian ng lupa, ay nakakaapekto sa climate dahil nagsisilbing harang ang mga bundok sa paggalaw ng hangin at moisture.
copy.bis: Ang topography, o ang pisikal nga porma ug kinaiya sa yuta, nakaapekto sa climate tungod kay ang mga bukid nagsilbi nga babag sa paglihok sa hangin ug moisture.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: the total mechanical energy at the initial position, point B, and point D remains the same
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how interaction between living things and interactions between living and non-living things may bring good or harm to the living things involved
assignedReviews.reason: Conservation of mechanical energy is not how an interaction brings good or harm.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use information from secondary sources to describe that living things interact with each other in the natural environment, such as through competition, or predation
assignedReviews.reason: The card is not living things interacting through competition or predation.

copy.en: For an object rolling from a height, the total mechanical energy at the initial position, point B, and point D remains the same.
copy.tl: Para sa isang bagay na gumugulong mula sa taas, ang total mechanical energy sa initial position, point B, at point D ay nananatiling pareho.
copy.bis: Alang sa usa ka butang nga nagligid, ang total mechanical energy sa initial position, point B, ug point D magpabilin nga pareho.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A toucan has a large, broad beak that helps it reach and pick fruits from branches.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the role of DNA, genes, and chromosomes in the transmission of traits
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a toucan's beak and its function in feeding. It does not address DNA, genes, chromosomes, or the transmission of traits, which are the core of G9-L-2. The card is unrelated to genetics.

copy.en: A toucan has a large, broad beak that helps it reach and pick fruits from branches.
copy.tl: Ang toucan ay may malaki at malapad na tuka na tumutulong sa kanya na maabot at mapitas ang mga prutas mula sa mga sanga.
copy.bis: Ang toucan adunay dako ug lapad nga sungo nga makatabang niya sa pag-abot ug pagpupo sa mga prutas gikan sa mga sanga.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Toxoplasma gondii is a protist commonly found in cats
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use a table to show how living things can be classified into groups based on similar characteristics (plants including flowering and non-flowering; animals including mammals, reptiles, insects, birds, fish, amphibians; microorganisms including fungi and bacteria)
assignedReviews.reason: The competency requires using a table to classify living things into named groups (plants, animals, microorganisms including fungi and bacteria). The card discusses a specific protist and its risk in pregnancy; it does not classify organisms, does not use a table, and protists are not among the named microorganism groups in the competency. The content is unrelated to classification.

copy.en:
Why is Toxoplasma risky for pregnant women?

Toxoplasma gondii is a protist commonly found in cats, and it can harm a developing baby's brain if a pregnant woman gets infected.
copy.tl:
Bakit delikado sa buntis ang Toxoplasma?

Ang Toxoplasma gondii ay isang protist na karaniwang nasa mga pusa, at maaari nitong mapinsala ang utak ng sanggol kung mahawa ang isang buntis.
copy.bis:
Nganong delikado sa buntis ang Toxoplasma?

Ang Toxoplasma gondii usa ka protist nga kasagaran naa sa mga pusa, ug mahimong makadaot sa utak sa bata kon matakdan ang usa ka buntis.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: If it accelerates at 1.25 m/s² for 20 seconds, its final velocity becomes 25 m/s!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate how friction can produce heat and investigate ways of reducing and increasing friction
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about calculating final velocity from acceleration and time. It does not address friction, heat production, or reducing/increasing friction at all.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: If it accelerates at 1.25 m/s² for 20 seconds, its final velocity becomes 25 m/s!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain that the mechanical energy of an object is the sum of the kinetic energy and the potential energy available to do work
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about kinematics (acceleration and final velocity), not about mechanical energy as the sum of kinetic and potential energy. No energy concepts are mentioned.

copy.en:
How fast can an LRT train go after starting from rest?

If it accelerates at 1.25 m/s² for 20 seconds, its final velocity becomes 25 m/s!
copy.tl:
Gaano kabilis ang LRT train pagkatapos magsimula mula sa pagtigil?

Kung ito ay nag-a-accelerate sa 1.25 m/s² sa loob ng 20 segundo, ang final velocity nito ay magiging 25 m/s!
copy.bis:
Unsa kapaspas ang LRT train human magsugod gikan sa pagpundo?

Kung kini nag-accelerate sa 1.25 m/s² sa 20 ka segundo, ang final velocity niini mahimong 25 m/s!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Transformer equations relate voltage and current to the number of coil turns
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe a valence electron as an electron in the outer shell of an atom that can take part in formation of bonds
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses transformer voltage/current relationships, a physics/electromagnetism topic. G9-M-3 requires describing valence electrons and chemical bonding, which is entirely unrelated.

copy.en: Transformer equations relate voltage and current to the number of coil turns, so changing the turns changes the voltage and current.
copy.tl: Ang transformer equations ay nag-uugnay ng voltage at current sa bilang ng coil turns, kaya kapag binago ang turns, nagbabago rin ang voltage at current.
copy.bis: Ang transformer equations nag-ugnay sa voltage ug current sa gidaghanon sa coil turns, busa kon usbon ang turns, mausab usab ang voltage ug current.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: translation initiation
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how soil is formed from rocks and minerals
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes the molecular process of translation initiation in protein synthesis. It has no relation to soil formation from rocks and minerals, which is the subject of G5-E-4.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: translation initiation
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe the outer parts of plants, such as leaves, roots, and stems and identify their role to get water and nutrients from the soil
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about ribosome binding to mRNA and tRNA anticodons, not about observing outer parts of plants or their roles in water and nutrient uptake. It does not support G3-L-5.

copy.en: During translation initiation, the small and large subunits of the ribosome bind to the mRNA at the start codon, and a tRNA with the matching anticodon joins them.
copy.tl: Sa translation initiation, ang small at large subunits ng ribosome ay dumidikit sa mRNA sa start codon, at isang tRNA na may katugmang anticodon ang sumasali sa kanila.
copy.bis: Sa translation initiation, ang small ug large subunits sa ribosome mopilit sa mRNA sa start codon, ug usa ka tRNA nga may katugbang nga anticodon ang moapil kanila.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Transparent materials allow light to pass through completely, while translucent materials only partly allow light to get through.

assignedReviews.reason: The card is about light transmission through materials (transparent vs. translucent), which is a physics/light topic. G3-L-7 is about living things depending on one another and on the environment to meet basic needs. There is no connection to living things, interdependence, or environmental needs.

copy.en: Transparent materials allow light to pass through completely, while translucent materials only partly allow light to get through.
copy.tl: Ang mga transparent na materyales ay nagpapadaan ng liwanag nang buo, samantalang ang mga translucent na materyales ay bahagya lamang nagpapadaan ng liwanag.
copy.bis: Ang mga transparent nga materyales magpalatas sa kahayag sa hingpit, samtang ang mga translucent nga materyales partially lamang magpalatas sa kahayag.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain that the formation of new bonds or the breaking of existing bonds constitutes a chemical change and the formation of a new substance
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes animal group travel and mutual protection, which is unrelated to chemical bonding, bond formation/breaking, or chemical change. The assigned competency is a chemistry topic and receives no instructional support from this card.

copy.en: Monkeys, elephants, and penguins travel in family groups, and when danger comes they gather together to protect each other.
copy.tl: Ang mga unggoy, elepante, at penguin ay naglalakbay nang magkakasama bilang pamilya, at kapag may panganib ay nagsasama-sama sila para protektahan ang isa't isa.
copy.bis: Ang mga unggoy, elepante, ug penguin nagbiyahe sa mga grupo sa pamilya, ug kung adunay peligro magtigom sila aron panalipdan ang usag usa.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The triangulation method uses three seismic stations to locate an earthquake epicenter!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe different science process skills used in performing simple science activities, such as observing, predicting, and measuring using units such as millimeter, centimeter, and meter
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches the triangulation method for locating an earthquake epicenter, a specific earth science technique. It does not describe science process skills such as observing, predicting, or measuring with units like millimeter, centimeter, or meter as required by G3-M-4. The content is unrelated to the Grade 3 matter competency.

copy.en:
How do scientists find an earthquake's epicenter?

The triangulation method uses three seismic stations to locate an earthquake epicenter!
copy.tl:
Paano hinahanap ng mga scientist ang epicenter ng lindol?

Ginagamit ng triangulation method ang tatlong seismic stations para mahanap ang epicenter ng lindol!
copy.bis:
Giunsa pagpangita sa mga scientist ang epicenter sa linog?

Ang triangulation method mogamit ug tulo ka seismic stations aron makit-an ang epicenter sa linog!

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate how different factors affect the solubility of a solute in a given solvent, such as heat
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a triple-beam balance, a tool for measuring mass. It provides no information about factors affecting solubility of a solute in a solvent, such as heat. The topic is unrelated to the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: It is a mechanical balance with three beams and sliding weights
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe useful everyday examples of uniform and non-uniform mixtures, such as solutions and suspensions
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a triple-beam balance, a tool for measuring mass. It does not describe uniform or non-uniform mixtures, solutions, or suspensions. The content is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en:
What is a triple-beam balance?

It is a mechanical balance with three beams and sliding weights that you move until the object and the weights are balanced!
copy.tl:
Ano ang triple-beam balance?

Ito ay isang mechanical balance na may tatlong beams at sliding weights na ginagalaw mo hanggang mag-balance ang bagay at ang mga weights!
copy.bis:
Unsa ang triple-beam balance?

Kini usa ka mechanical balance nga adunay tulo ka beams ug sliding weights nga imong lihokon hangtod mag-balance ang butang ug ang mga weights!

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify examples of everyday situations that demonstrate: a. kinetic energy being transformed to potential energy, and b. potential energy being transformed to kinetic energy
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about investigation validity and reliability, not about kinetic energy being transformed to potential energy or vice versa. It provides no support for identifying everyday examples of energy transformations.

copy.tl: Ang isang valid na investigation ay patas na sumusubok sa hypothesis, at dapat din itong maging accurate at reliable para pagkatiwalaan.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the general structure of the solar system, identifying the names of the major celestial objects, their main features, and general composition
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes tsunami hazards and their impacts on coastal communities, which is unrelated to the solar system structure, celestial objects, or their composition required by G5-E-11.

copy.tl: Ang tsunami ay maaaring bumaha sa mga komunidad sa baybayin, tangayin ang mga gusali at bangka, at mag-iwan ng tubig-alat na sumisira sa sakahan at inuming tubig.
copy.bis: Ang tsunami makabaha sa mga komunidad sa baybayon, maka-anod sa mga bilding ug sakayan, ug magbilin ug parat nga tubig nga makadaot sa uma ug mainom nga tubig.

assignedReviews.reason: The card is about biomes, not faults, earthquakes, or Philippine fault systems. It provides no support for explaining how movements along faults generate earthquakes.

copy.en: Tundra and taiga are examples of biomes, which are large areas of Earth with similar climates and types of organisms.
copy.tl: Ang tundra at taiga ay mga halimbawa ng biome, na malalaking bahagi ng Earth na may magkakatulad na klima at uri ng mga organism.
copy.bis: Ang tundra ug taiga mga pananglitan sa biome, nga dagkong mga parte sa Earth nga adunay parehas nga klima ug matang sa mga organismo.

Why do we need two eyes?

We use both eyes together to see depth and judge how far away something is.
copy.tl:
Bakit kailangan natin ng dalawang mata?

Ginagamit natin ang ating dalawang mata nang sabay para makita ang lalim at malaman kung gaano kalayo ang isang bagay.
copy.bis:
Nganong kinahanglan nato ang duha ka mata?

Gigamit nato ang atong duha ka mata nga dungan aron makita ang giladmon ug masuta kung unsa kalayo ang usa ka butang.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A physical change only alters appearance or state, but a chemical change produces new substances with different properties.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: draw the structure of an atom in terms of the nucleus and electron shells
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses physical vs chemical change, which is unrelated to drawing the structure of an atom in terms of nucleus and electron shells.

copy.tl: Ang physical change ay binabago lamang ang itsura o estado, ngunit ang chemical change ay gumagawa ng mga bagong substance na may ibang katangian.
copy.bis: Ang physical change nag-usab lamang sa dagway o estado, apan ang chemical change moporma og bag-ong mga substance nga lahi ang mga kinaiya.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Sexual reproduction in flowering plants
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how plate tectonics can be used to explain the formation of the largest mountain ranges on Earth including the Himalayas and the Andes mountains

assignedReviews.reason: Card is about plant sexual reproduction; competency is about plate boundary structures and movements. No relation.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Sexual reproduction in flowering plants
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the types of plate boundaries found around the Earth
assignedReviews.reason: Card is about plant sexual reproduction; competency is about types of plate boundaries. No relation.

copy.en: Sexual reproduction in flowering plants involves both a male parent and a female parent, and their sex cells join to form a seed.

copy.en: In the Philippines, babies start getting vaccines on a schedule from the health center — early, because a newborn's defenses are still weak and need to learn early.
copy.tl: Sa Pilipinas, sinisimulan ang pagbabakuna habang sanggol pa, ayon sa iskedyul mula sa health center — maaga ito dahil mahina pa ang depensa ng bagong silang at kailangang matuto nang maaga.
copy.bis: Sa Pilipinas, ang pagbakuna magsugod samtang masuso pa, subay sa iskedyul gikan sa health center — sayo kini kay huyang pa ang panalipod sa bag-ong natawo ug kinahanglan makakat-on og sayo.

copy.en:
How does a vaccine work?

It trains your immune system using a dead or weak piece of a germ, so your body is ready to fight if the real disease ever comes.
copy.tl:
Paano gumagana ang bakuna?

Sinasanay nito ang immune system gamit ang patay o mahinang bahagi ng germ, kaya handa na ang katawan kapag dumating ang tunay na sakit.
copy.bis:
Giunsa paglihok ang bakuna?

Gibansay niini ang imong immune system gamit ang patay o luya nga bahin sa kagaw, aron andam ang lawas kon moabot ang tinuod nga sakit.
